aggisālā.p: [Aggi+sālā] (thī) CL=9 (1) Hut with fire. A hut with fire for worshipping the fire. See also Aggiṭṭhā, aggiyāyana, agyāgāra-.(2) a diaphoretic(cause perspiration) house in the cold regions, whic is used for preventing diseases caused by snow.
